about: Evaporation, drying and distillation: rotary evaporator, freeze dryer, spray dryer, critical point dryer, centrifugal concentrator, fractional distillation, wiped-film still.

excluded.binder_vd56: a vacuum drying oven: its temperature control is in the thermal class and its vacuum valves are shared open/close parts; it has no drying run (start/stop/result) to put here
excluded.vacuubrand_pc3001_vario_select: a vacuum source, primary in gas_fluid (setpoint pressure, start, stop, vent); the rotavap points to it as the vacuum source

set-temp:heat.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

set-temp:heat.message: the heating bath of {inst} is not ready (no bath fluid registered by the lab; the bath temperature is unknown).
set-temp:heat.fix: ask the lab to fill the bath; meanwhile `chemlab run {inst} rotate SPEED` works without heating.

rotate.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.message: {inst} is switched off.

thermal.set_temperature:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: {inst} heats only: the bath set point must be at least room temperature.
thermal.set_temperature:INVALID_ARGUMENT.fix: give a set point at or above room temperature (about 20 °C).

timer.set_duration:INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: the timer of {inst} takes whole minutes only.
timer.set_duration:INVALID_ARGUMENT.fix: give the time in whole minutes, e.g. time=30min.

thermal.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: the heating bath of {inst} is not ready (switched off, or no bath fluid registered).
thermal.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: switch {inst} on; if the bath temperature reads null, ask the lab to fill the bath.

unsupported.vacuum: the vacuum comes from an external pump (the vacuum source is a VACUUBRAND PC 3001 VARIO select); the RV 10 itself has no vacuum controller
unsupported.endpoint: no drying endpoint (a rotary evaporator runs until stopped or until its timer ends)
unsupported.condenser: the condenser is cooled by an external chiller (no set point here)
unsupported.feed: no feed pump (the flask is charged by hand)

alternatives.vacuum: set the pressure on the pump: `chemlab run vacuubrand_pc3001_vario_select` lists its verbs (or `chemlab call vacuubrand_pc3001_vario_select vacuum.set_pressure --pressure_pa 17500`); the rotavap reads it back as vacuum.indicated_pressure_pa.
alternatives.preheat: `chemlab run INST set-temp 40C --heat` switches the bath heating on.

start: start = bath heating on + rotation on (no single run object on the RV 10); with a timer set (method time=30min) it gives a job that ends when the timer stops the rotation.
manual: operating manual p. 22, p. 21 (START_X / STOP_X)
method: the RV 10 has no method object: keys time (timer, whole minutes; 0 = off), interval (rotation reversal, 0-60 s), temp, speed are sent to their own set points.
lift: up = flask raised out of the bath, down = lowest position (into the bath).
set-temp: manual: operating manual pp. 18-20 (heating bath), p. 21 (NAMUR commands)

set-temp.message: a freeze-drying cycle is running on {inst}; it takes this setting only between cycles.
set-temp.fix: wait for the cycle to end (`chemlab wait JOB`) or stop it: `chemlab run {inst} stop`.

vacuum.message: a freeze-drying cycle is running on {inst}; it takes this setting only between cycles.
vacuum.fix: wait for the cycle to end (`chemlab wait JOB`) or stop it: `chemlab run {inst} stop`.

method.message: a freeze-drying cycle is running on {inst}; it takes this setting only between cycles.

endpoint.message: a freeze-drying cycle is running on {inst}; it takes this setting only between cycles.
endpoint.fix: wait for the cycle to end (`chemlab wait JOB`) or stop it: `chemlab run {inst} stop`.

start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.message: the drying chamber of {inst} is open.
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close chamber`.

start.message: no sample is loaded in {inst} (loading frozen samples is the lab's set-up).
start.fix: ask the lab to load the pre-frozen samples.

start.message: the sample in {inst} is not confirmed pre-frozen.
start.fix: the samples must be frozen before loading; ask the lab.

start.message: {inst} has no recipe (phase durations) yet.
start.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method freeze=2h primary=20h secondary=4h`.

start.message: the vacuum source of {inst} cannot reach the vacuum set point (or no source is connected).
start.fix: raise the set point within what the pump reaches (`chemlab run {inst} vacuum 100Pa`), or ask the lab to connect a suitable pump.

start.message: a cycle is already running on {inst}.
start.fix: follow it with `chemlab wait JOB`, or stop it first.

unsupported.condenser: the ice condenser runs at its own fixed temperature (no set point)

method: keys freeze / primary / secondary (phase durations) make the recipe; a phase left out keeps the stored recipe; shelf, pressure, protect go to their own set points.
manual: operating manual pp. 43-51 (methods, steps and phases)
start: the cycle runs pre-freeze, primary and secondary drying and ends "complete"; it waits (cycle.wait_reason) while the vacuum or temperatures are not there.
manual: operating manual pp. 40-42 (manual freeze-drying), pp. 52-56 (method-based)
endpoint: manual: operating manual pp. 43-51 (end point definition)

lyophilization.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} refused the start although power, chamber, sample, recipe and vacuum are ready: the moisture endpoint needs a drying-rate model the lab has not configured.
lyophilization.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: end on schedule instead (`chemlab run {inst} endpoint schedule`), or ask the lab for the drying model.

lyophilization.stop:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: nothing to do; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.
